svg.title: Gaussian mutual information
svg.desc: What this figure shows: For jointly Gaussian scalars, mutual information depends only on |rho| and diverges as |rho| approaches one. The plotted object is generated from I(X;Y)=-1/2 log(1-rho^2). How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Closed-form information-theoretic fact. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
